import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts(dropna=True).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich Registrations', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
